items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Harlan was in the band but he wasn't -- he didn't have it to run his band at the first time

ctx.x: He capped everybody with that -- that'd do it you know. So the guys who were in London came. And they -- there was -- they had some kind of a thing going on where the guys were fighting each other or something. You know -- disagreeing -- in the Bennie Moten (PHONETIC) band. So they -- they split. Half of them went one way and half went the other. The one that went -- that wasn't -- that didn't stay with Bennie -- was Kevin Hayes (PHONETIC), he took the band. There was Kevin Hayes (PHONETIC) and we stayed together…
Yeah. Harlan was in the band but he wasn't -- he didn't have it to run his band at the first time -- you know.
